entries.alt: Four fictional adult women smile together at a Guaita tower overlook on Mount Titano, wearing sharply shortened blue, pearl, red and green fashion looks with rainbow knee-high stockings and complete pumps.

Four fictional adult women share an affectionate fashion pose below San Marino's Cesta tower, wearing sharply shortened jewel-tone outfits, rainbow knee-high stockings and star-accented pumps as distant smoke rises across the panorama.
Four fictional adult women stand arm in arm in Piazza della Liberta before Palazzo Pubblico, wearing sharply shortened metallic RAZE looks with rainbow over-knee stockings and complete pumps.

Four fictional adult women pose warmly beside the Borgo Maggiore cableway beneath Mount Titano, wearing sharply shortened split-star outfits and tall blue, pearl, red and green RAZE boots with rainbow cutouts and star heels.
